messages:
Maya: Hey team — marketing needs a tiny, audit-ready bench pack for the launch page and webinar. Required: P50/P95/P99 token latency, tokens/sec, and cost per 1k tokens. Also want 10 raw traces per workload and the exact run command. Goal: compact, reproducible, and press-friendly. Target: by EOD Fri if possible.
Sam: On it. Which models/quant levels and workloads? Also confirm batching and streaming defaults.
Maya: Two models: redwood-rlhf-1 (fp16 baseline) and redwood-slim-quant (int8). Workloads: (A) short chat (~48 tokens) (B) long completion (~1800 tokens). Keep streaming disabled; conservative batch size. I'll attach sample prompts: https://redwood.internal/launch/bench-samples
Leo: I can run. Proposal: 1k requests per workload, fixed seed, single-AZ (us-east-1a), warmup 250 requests, batch_size=6, streaming off. Collect P50/P95/P99 (request start->last token), throughput in tok/s, and cost/1k. I will export 10 full traces per workload and the run command.
Anya: Also want a 1-paragraph methodology blurb and a one-line FAQ for the press about reproducibility. Plus note about lead routing: demo CTA -> Growth SDR by default.
Sam: Queuing two jobs per workload (fp16 + int8). If int8 shows >12% quality drop on the evaluation prompts, we’ll avoid aggressive cost claims and instead provide a conservative delta with a note about quality tradeoffs.
benchbot: queued: job_id=jb-9021 model=redwood-rlhf-1 config=fp16 workload=short started=1717669200
benchbot: queued: job_id=jb-9022 model=redwood-slim-quant config=int8 workload=short started=1717669300
benchbot: queued: job_id=jb-9023 model=redwood-rlhf-1 config=fp16 workload=long started=1717669400
benchbot: queued: job_id=jb-9024 model=redwood-slim-quant config=int8 workload=long started=1717669500
Sam: exact run command for reproducibility (copypaste):
```bash
./bench_runner --model redwood-rlhf-1 --quant none --warmup 250 --requests 1000 --batch 6 --region us-east-1a --seed 1234 --streaming false --out artifacts/jb-9021
```
Leo: Will similarly run int8 with --quant int8 and matching seed/out path.

benchbot: finished: job_id=jb-9022 status=success p50=16.5ms p95=53.0ms p99=88.4ms throughput=1070 tok/s cost_per_1k=0.030 quality_delta_eval=-3.8%
benchbot: finished: job_id=jb-9023 status=success p50=120.4ms p95=342.8ms p99=590.2ms throughput=760 tok/s cost_per_1k=0.195
benchbot: finished: job_id=jb-9024 status=success p50=98.6ms p95=284.1ms p99=492.0ms throughput=920 tok/s cost_per_1k=0.138 quality_delta_eval=-4.6%
Sam: Artifacts uploaded: https://redwood.internal/bench/artifacts/jb-9021 (and jb-9022/jb-9023/jb-9024). Method blurb draft: Single AZ (us-east-1a), 1k requests, fixed RNG seed, 250 warmup, batch=6, streaming disabled. Latencies measured from request start to final token. 10 raw traces attached for each workload.
Maya: This is great — please include the exact command block in the press assets and a tiny FAQ: "How reproducible are these numbers?" -> "Within the same region/config expect ~±10% variance; cross-region or different batching can shift results more. Contact runtime@redwood for SLA estimates."
Leo: Note for copy: prefer wording like "P95 observed in this benchmark" rather than "P95 guaranteed". Include link to artifacts and methodology.
Anya: Routing note: once blog/live demo publishes, inbound demo signups go to Growth SDR unless a user requests enterprise/dedicated capacity. I'll wire the webhook.
Maya: Thanks — I'll draft the launch copy and webinar script using these numbers. If anyone catches a surprising regression on int8, flag it.
Sam: Will follow up with the final one-paragraph method text and the small FAQ line in a separate paste.
Maya: Appreciate it — timeline still EOD Fri. :rocket:
